# Remover Metadados / Metadata Remover

> A free, 100% client-side online tool to permanently remove metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) from photos, PDFs, and documents — directly in your browser. No uploads, no servers, no data leaves your device.

## Key Facts

- **Primary Language**: Portuguese (Brazil) — `https://remover-metadados.com/`
- **English Version**: `https://remover-metadados.com/en/`
- **Processing**: Entirely client-side using HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly, jszip, pdf-lib, and piexifjs
- **Privacy**: Zero data transmission — files never leave the user's browser
- **Supported Formats**: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF (images) · MP4, MOV, M4V, MP3 (video/audio) · PDF · DOCX, XLSX, PPTX (Office documents)
